questions: If the flattened list is empty (e.g., L = [] or L = [[]]), what should the function return?
Should the function handle non-integer elements (e.g., floats, strings) or only integers as implied by the signature and tests?
If there are multiple modes with the same frequency, does the clarification 'smallest element' refer to the smallest by value or the first encountered in flattened order?
Is the nested list guaranteed to be rectangular (all sublists same length) or can sublists vary in length as shown in tests?
